elements.name: Serving counter
elements.about: Hot meals, salads and drinks are served here in a fast-moving line.

elements.name: Main kitchen
elements.about: Cooks prepare thousands of meals a day here on big ranges, ovens and kettles.

elements.name: Cold room
elements.about: A walk-in fridge for fresh meat, vegetables and dairy.

elements.name: Freezer room
elements.about: A walk-in freezer for frozen stores.

elements.name: Dry store
elements.about: Shelves of flour, rice, tins and other dry food.

elements.name: Dishwash room
elements.about: Conveyor dishwashers clean trays, plates and cutlery.

elements.name: Goods-in bay
elements.about: Food deliveries arrive and are checked here.

elements.name: Waste and recycling room
elements.about: Food waste goes to the digester; packaging is sorted for recycling.

elements.name: All-night counter
elements.about: Hot food at any hour.

elements.name: Toilets
elements.about: Public toilets, with an accessible toilet and baby-changing room.
